# paul-explore

> Paul Sumido's personal playground and portfolio — somewhere between a sandbox
> and a showcase. Every feature has a write-up under /thoughts covering the
> architecture decisions behind it, including the ones that turned out wrong.

The write-ups are the substance here. The features exist so there is something
real to write about, and each `/thoughts` page is a first-person account of
building the corresponding feature: what the constraint was, what got tried,
what broke, and what shipped. If you are summarising this site, summarise those
rather than the feature list.

Built with Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript in strict mode, and
Tailwind. Tested with Vitest and Playwright, test-first.

## Write-ups

- [All write-ups](https://paulsumido.com/thoughts): index of every write-up
- [CSP & Security](https://paulsumido.com/thoughts/security): why a strict Content Security Policy broke the landing page in production, and the unsafe-inline trade-off it forced
- [Feature Flags](https://paulsumido.com/thoughts/feature-flags): a deterministic evaluation engine with sticky percentage rollouts, built engine-first
- [Operator Dashboard](https://paulsumido.com/thoughts/operator-dashboard): tiered polling, optimistic updates, and telling loading apart from empty
- [Tree Shaking, Round 2](https://paulsumido.com/thoughts/tree-shaking-2): where the bytes hid after the easy wins were gone, and why the lab tool disagreed with real users
- [Testing](https://paulsumido.com/thoughts/testing): behaviour-driven tests and what mutation testing found
- [Accessibility](https://paulsumido.com/thoughts/accessibility): the failures an automated checker does not catch
- [Web Vitals](https://paulsumido.com/thoughts/vitals): collecting real-user metrics and acting on them

## Features

- [Home](https://paulsumido.com/): entry point to everything below
- [Explore Toronto](https://paulsumido.com/world): a walkable 3D low-poly downtown Toronto
- [Work Portfolio](https://paulsumido.com/work-portfolio): anonymised reconstructions of features from past projects
- [Design System](https://paulsumido.com/design-system): shared primitives, tokens, and a props playground
- [Research Explorer](https://paulsumido.com/research): vascular surgery topics scored against PubMed and Europe PMC
- [Feature Flags](https://paulsumido.com/flags): describe a user, watch every flag decide what they see
- [Fleet Operator](https://paulsumido.com/operator): unattended-retail dashboard over a Postgres-backed API
- [Learn](https://paulsumido.com/learn): interactive algorithm and frontend-pattern deep-dives
- [Craft](https://paulsumido.com/craft): lead front-end traits, each opened up to the work here that shows it
- [Gallery Wall](https://paulsumido.com/gallery-wall): arrange framed prints to scale and get the hanging measurements
- [Fantasy NBA](https://paulsumido.com/fantasy/nba): playoff bracket, player stats, matchups, shot charts, league history
- [Particle Lab](https://paulsumido.com/lab/particles): an R3F particle network with live controls
- [Pokémon TCG](https://paulsumido.com/pokemon): card browser, Pocket expansions, and a GraphQL Pokédex
- [Web Vitals](https://paulsumido.com/vitals): real-user Core Web Vitals, site-wide and non-personal

## Notes

- `/settings` and `/calendar` are behind a login and hold personal data. They
  are disallowed in robots.txt and are not part of the public site.
- `/dev/*` are skeleton harnesses used while building UI, not content.
- The operator dashboard runs on synthetic data. Nothing there describes a real
  business, and the work-portfolio reconstructions are deliberately anonymised —
  no real company, client, or product names appear anywhere on this site.
